title: rest/metadata-protocol: GET /meta/app's nav-servability gate zod-diagnoses every served object to read their enable flags, and every served metadata list recomputes _diagnostics on every read: 34% of a hosted tenant console open's server CPU, measured
body:
Filing gate: ① a measured defect (server CPU on the console open path), found by cloud's attribution round cloud#2914 round 10 (report: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/2914#issuecomment-6396581531). Platform-first: cloud's own frames are 0–3% of every call below, so the fix is here.

Session: `session_01FSg7JRUiTPo8GrgT38tAWP` · seat `repo:cloud#1`

**Business reason.** Opening a hosted tenant console currently costs about 501 ms of main-thread server CPU on one event loop (measured on a local hosted-shaped rig). On staging the per-call CPU reads about 4–8× that, which puts 2–4 s of the measured ~5.0 s open on the server. Two framework behaviours cost **169 ms (34%)** of it, and neither is needed by anything on the open path.

**Reader who acts.** A framework dev for `packages/rest` and `packages/metadata-protocol`.

## Measured (cloud `main` `36b07fdf`, framework pin `888d6865`, objectui `6f629a73`, HotCRM 5.0.0 with sample data, zh-CN)

Each call was measured isolated and serially: 40 requests after 5 warm-ups. CPU is main-thread CPU from `/proc`. Profiles are V8 CPU profiles at 250 µs sampling.

| call | CPU / wall | `computeMetadataDiagnostics` share | what is served |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| tenant `GET /api/v1/meta/app` | 79.8 / 77.6 ms | **67.6 ms (74%)** | 3 apps, whose own diagnostics cost 0.04–0.22 ms |
| control plane `GET /api/v1/meta/app` | 67.5 / 64.3 ms | 58.5 ms (75%), over 99 objects | — |
| tenant `GET /api/v1/meta/object` (whole registry) | 98.8 / 101.3 ms | 71.1 ms (63%), over 102 objects | 875 KB raw |
| tenant `GET /api/v1/meta/view` | 20.5 / 20.8 ms | 7.0 ms (31%), over 110 views | — |

### 1. `meta/app`'s nav-servability gate reads the SERVED object list

- `GET /meta/app` runs `resolveNavServability` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:1295-1303`), which calls `loadObjectItems` (`:441-445`).
- That goes through `metaListSource` (`rest-server.ts:3643-3652`) to `protocol.getMetaItems`, which is the served face.
- So every object is decorated and zod-diagnosed only to learn its enable flag. A breakpoint count in one request showed 3 app items and 102 object items diagnosed.

This is the same class as #24031, which fixed it for the `/data` API-exposure gate. This is the `/meta/app` door.

**Fix sketch:** read a name → enable-flag projection, or the execution face, rather than the served list.

**Expected:** tenant `meta/app` CPU drops from 80 to about 12 ms, and control plane from 68 to about 10 ms.

### 2. Every served metadata list recomputes `_diagnostics` on every read

- The diagnostics are a full zod `safeParse` per item (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:10175`, `metadata-diagnostics.ts:154-171`).
- Their reader is Studio. Nothing on the console open path reads them.

**Fix sketch:** memoize per stored item version, or compute them only when the caller asks (a Studio query flag).

**Expected:** tenant `meta/object` drops by 71 ms and `meta/view` by 7 ms.

## Acceptance

1. With the cloud#2914 rig, or any hosted-shaped rig with about 100 objects: `GET /meta/app` costs at most 15 ms main-thread CPU, and `GET /meta/object` with no Studio flag spends at most 5% of its CPU in `computeMetadataDiagnostics`. Report the before and after numbers.
2. Studio's diagnostics surfaces still show the same verdicts. Re-pin the tests that read `_diagnostics`.
3. #24031's gate test family covers the `/meta/app` door too.

## Dedupe

- `search_issues` for 'computeMetadataDiagnostics served metadata list zod diagnostics every read meta/app nav servability' returned 9 hits, all closed. The nearest is #24031, the `/data` sibling, fixed.
- No open card covers the `/meta/app` gate or per-read diagnostics.

## 维护者速读

托管租户打开控制台时，服务端 CPU 有 34% 花在框架"每次读元数据都重新跑一遍 zod 诊断"上：`/meta/app` 为了判断导航项能否显示，把全部 102 个对象都诊断了一遍（只为读一个开关，和已修的 #24031 同一类问题）；`/meta/object` 每次也全量诊断。诊断结果只有 Studio 用。修复后租户打开约省 170 ms 服务端 CPU（staging 上按 4–8 倍估计约 0.7–1.3 秒）。
